auth.invalid: That email and password don't match.

auth.driverWelcomeBody: Your location is shared only while a trip is running.

register.subtitle: The depot reviews every application. You can sign in once you're approved.

register.aadhaarNote: Use a masked Aadhaar (only the last 4 digits visible). Never upload a full Aadhaar number.
register.photoHint: Lay the card flat in good light so every word is readable.
register.cameraDenied: Allow camera access to take photos of your documents.

application.pendingBody: The depot will check your details and documents. We'll notify you here when there's a decision.
application.approvedBody: Welcome aboard. Sign in to see your bus and start trips.

driver.noBusBody: The depot will assign you a bus. Pull down to refresh.

driver.queued_one: {{count}} position saved offline — sends when you're back online
driver.queued_other: {{count}} positions saved offline — send when you're back online

location.warningBody: Location has been off for 15 seconds. Turn it on now.
location.escalatedBody: Your location stayed off after 2 warnings. Turn it on to continue the trip.
location.permissionBody: Location is needed to share the bus position during trips.
location.backgroundBody: Choose “Allow all the time” so tracking continues when the screen is off.
location.notificationBody: Your location is shared with the depot during this trip.

panic.holdHint: Hold for 2 seconds to send an emergency alert
panic.sentBody: The control room has your location.
panic.acknowledged: The control room has seen your alert
panic.resolved: The control room has closed this alert

panic.failed: Couldn't send the alert. Call 112 now.
